Indore Traders Protest UPI MDR Charges with 'No UPI Day'

Traders in Indore observed a 'No UPI Day' to protest a proposed 0.4% MDR (Merchant Discount Rate) charge on UPI transactions. They covered QR codes with black cloth and held a torch rally to express their opposition to the fee.
